name: Table
summary: Data in rows and columns in a TableCard with a header, Table toolbar and Table bulk actions. In Figma you add columns through a slot and choose the number of rows with Rows.
use: Data the user wants to compare, sort or scan.
avoid: Little data per item: think about a list or Cards.
anatomy: TableCard: title, badge and primary action (optional).
Table toolbar: search, filters, columns, export.
Table bulk actions: number selected and actions, only when there is a selection.
Header cells: label, sort icon, optional checkbox.
Body cells: text, text + supporting text, avatar, badge or actions.
figmaProps: Table: Show action / toolbar / bulk actions / empty state
Add a column: duplicate a Table column (Cmd+D) or drag one in.
Text, Text + supporting, Avatar, Badge, Actions, Checkbox, Loading
Select all columns and choose Rows in one go.
Table toolbar: Show search / filters / columns / export
Table bulk actions: Count / Show action / Show destructive action
Text, Text + supporting, Avatar, Badge, Actions
reactProps: actions: primary action on the right, for example "Add team member".
Search and filters on the left, columns and export on the right.
For an EmptyState inside the table.
behaviour: Sortable headers are buttons. Clicking switches the direction.
The toolbar and the selection bar are on screen at the same time. Changing the search or filters clears the selection.
Two empty states: no data yet (explanation and an add button, header without a button) and no search results (Clear search).
a11y: Checkboxes in rows have a label with the row name.
content: Short column headers. Align numbers right and text left.
do: Put the most important column on the left.
Combine with Pagination for long lists.
dont: The add button in the toolbar: it belongs in the table header or in the Page header.
Actions that only show on hover: keyboard and touch users miss them.
open: On small screens the table scrolls sideways. There is no stacked mobile view yet.
